<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|88|THE GOSPEL|CHA. I.}}</noinclude>{{hwe|sert.|desert.}} {{verse|chapter=1|verse=13}}† And he vvas in the desert fourtie daies, and fourtie nightes: and vvas tempted of Satan. and he vvas vvith beastes, and the Angels ministred to him.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=14}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 4, 12. Luc. 4, 14.''}}* after that Iohn vvas deliuered vp, {{sc|Iesvs}} came into Galilee, preaching the Gospel of the kingdom of God,{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text={{sc|The second}} part of this Gospel: of Christs manifestation.}} {{verse|chapter=1|verse=15}}† and saying, That the time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ He doth not preach beleefe or faith only, but penance also.}}∷ be penitent, and beleeue the Gospel.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=16}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 4, 18. Lu. 5, 2.''}}* And passing by the sea of Galilee, he savv Simon and Andrevv his brother, casting nettes into the sea (for they vvere fishers) {{verse|chapter=1|verse=17}}† and {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them, Come after me, and I vvil make you to become fishers of men. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=18}}† And immediatly leauing their nettes, they folovved him. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=19}}† And being gone thence a litle further, he savv Iames of Zebedee, and Iohn his brother, and them repairing their nettes in the shippe: {{verse|chapter=1|verse=20}}† and forthvvith he called them. And leauing their father Zebedee in the shippe vvith his hired men, they folovved him.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=21}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 4, 13. Lu. 4, 31.''}}* they enter into Capharnaum, and he forthvvith vpon the Sabboths going into the Synagogue, taught them. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=22}}† And they vvere astonied at his doctrine. for he vvas teaching them as hauing povver, and not as the Scribes. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=23}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 4, 32.''}}* there vvas in their Synagogue a man in an vncleane spirit: and he cried out, {{verse|chapter=1|verse=24}}† saying, What to vs and to thee {{sc|Iesvs}} of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy vs? I knovv vvho thou art, the Sainct of God. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=25}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} threatened him, saying, Hold thy peace, and goe out of the man. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=26}}† And the vncleane spirit tearing him, and crying out vvith a great voice, vvent out of him. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=27}}† And they marueled al, in so much that they questioned among them selues, saying, What thing is this? vvhat is this nevv doctrine? for vvith povver he commaundeth the vncleane spirits also, and they obey him. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=28}}† And the bruite of him vvent forth incontinent into al the countrie of Galilee.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=29}}† And immediatly {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 8, 14. Luc. 4, 42.''}}* going forth out of the Synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrevv, vvith Iames and Iohn. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=30}}† And Simons vviues mother lay in a fit of a feuer: and forthvvith they tel him of her. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=31}}† And comming neere he lifted her vp taking her by the hand: and incōtinent the ague left her, and she ministred vnto them. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=32}}† And vvhen it vvas euening after sunne set, they brought to him al that vvere il at ease and that had deuils. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=33}}† And al the citie vvas<noinclude>{{rh|||gathered}}</noinclude>
